scenarios.title: Diff выбранного файла
scenarios.implemented: Desktop EditorWindow has hash-checked save and Monaco conflict diff, with disk content vs pending buffer and grant-controlled overwrite. It does not silently synthesize empty buffer content.
scenarios.gaps: Diff exists only after a save conflict, with renderSideBySide:true fixed. There is no ordinary addressable selected-file Diff route/tab, revision and buffer generation selection or unified mode. M76 named by scenario/screen is the image/PDF owner; use M62 for Diff plus S13 shared source routes.
scenarios.prototype: Baseline scripts/product/operations.mjs:318 implements fixture file-diff from addressed file.disk/file.buffer with generation labels and split/unified controls, explicit missing source. scripts/test/product-operations.browser.cjs:25 covers this fixture path. Prototype source/test was inspected, not executed; fixture behavior is not production coverage.

scenarios.title: Документ и происхождение задач
scenarios.implemented: Idea recording sets task_type:idea and person origin; task UI offers research on backlog ideas; research creates another task and appends spawned link. TaskPage displays origin/assignment and clickable siblings. originDocument preserves trailing line handling and avoids splitting URL scheme.
scenarios.gaps: Origin ref remains plain text, no document/revision renderer route or immutable document version key. Siblings are sameDocument path based, not revision based; capped .limit(AUTOMATION_WINDOW) reported as total=siblingRows.length with read errors erased. Research handler reads no task_type/status, accepts any source task and invokes legacy startTask before origin link append. Direct admit_task_launch checks status/blockers/lease but has no idea task_type rejection; UI-only research affordance does not enforce no-idea-run invariant.
scenarios.prototype: Baseline operations.mjs:313 renders exact fixture document path, current disk revision and derived task list; source absence is explicit. Prototype uses mutable fixture diskRevision and task origin path; it does not prove immutable historical document revision or production admission. Browser fixture route inventory exists (product-integrated.browser.cjs:15), not executed in this slice.

packet_amendments.title: Add M62 selected-file Diff as bounded source-reader subtask; do not assign to media M76
packet_amendments.solution: Reuse Monaco diff and authoritative FileRef/disk hash/buffer generation; separate read-only diff from overwrite permission. Add exact selected-file route/tab with split/unified toggle and editor return.
steps: Define immutable comparison input {project,root,file,diskHash,bufferGeneration}; validate both sources before comparison.
Make ordinary editor/workspace Diff action open exact read-only pair, preserve unsaved buffer and mode.
Support split/unified, missing disk revision, stale read, unchanged and conflict without implicit save/overwrite.
Retain existing conflict-save flow; test actual renderer models and delayed source reads.
positive_acceptance: Ordinary edited buffer opens Diff without attempting save; exact before/after IDs visible.
Split/unified display identical changes; return restores buffer, cursor and scroll.
negative_acceptance: Missing historical disk version refuses compare, never substitutes empty/current unrelated text.
Switch file while loading cannot show late prior file diff; no read-only compare triggers grant/save.
exclusions: No independent new roadmap packet; this is a fourth source-reader subtask in AX-15.
No rewrite of shipped conflict diff or preview media implementation.
dependencies: UX28-06/AX-05 exact route and owned buffer contract; existing file-root boundary

packet_amendments.title: Complete two-way document provenance with exact revision and honest sibling coverage
packet_amendments.owner: M124 + S13; retain M130 assignment fields
packet_amendments.solution: DocumentRef must pin scope/path plus content revision or Git commit/blob. Distinguish current document from historical cited version; source resolver opens each honestly. Sibling grouping explicitly chooses same document vs same revision and exposes pagination/source failures.
steps: Extend canonical EntityRef with document revision; support legacy path-only refs as incomplete.
Render origin link to document viewer and derived tasks with exact source/return, preserving reference when denied/missing.
Return read-envelope and true/paginated sibling count; never use capped result length as full total.
Add fixtures for same path two revisions, same basename across projects, line refs, URLs, failed source and >AUTOMATION_WINDOW siblings.
positive_acceptance: Task→document revision→sibling→Back keeps same provenance scope.
Two tasks from different lines of same declared revision group correctly.
negative_acceptance: A revised document cannot silently replace cited historic content.
Unreadable sibling source cannot show empty list; capped list cannot claim complete total.
exclusions: No duplicate document bodies in task store.
Do not reimplement originDocument path parsing already shipped.
dependencies: AX-05 routes and S14 read envelope; AX-01 research provenance atomically recorded

packet_amendments.title: Enforce idea cannot run and make research creation recoverable
packet_amendments.solution: Admission refuses task_type:idea at authoritative boundary; research command validates source kind/status, records child origin/spawn link under stable command before child admission. Use common launch path rather than legacy startTask.
steps: Add authoritative no-idea-run refusal with source-type/status receipt.
Research command accepts stable command ID, checks intended idea revision and creates linked child idempotently.
Admit child through shared service only after provenance exists; expose admitted/failed/unknown to operator.
positive_acceptance: One valid idea research command creates one distinct child; idea stays backlog.
Child spawn failure leaves linked failed child receipt inspectable.
negative_acceptance: Direct IPC/RPC idea admission refuses even if UI bypassed.
Non-idea/terminal/stale source refuses research; timeout retry produces no duplicate child.
Failure between child creation and link cannot orphan provenance.
exclusions: No new packet or provider run; fold into AX-01 launch service acceptance.
dependencies: AX-01 common launch; S03 command boundary
